subject.title: [Feature]: Expose AI model used and usage cost when using openrouter/auto

question: What selected-versus-resolved model and provider-cost contract should OpenClaw expose for OpenRouter auto across assistant records, `session_status`/runtime metadata, usage templates, and response footers?
rationale: The remaining work crosses provider transport, session state, transcripts, and user-visible cost wording, so automation should not choose exact-versus-estimated cost semantics or metadata field shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Define Additive Contract
options.body: Preserve the selected `openrouter/auto` model, add resolved model/provider and provider-cost metadata, then render footer/status surfaces from that contract.

options.title: Limit To Footer
options.body: Only append the resolved model in response footers, accepting that session/runtime and template surfaces remain inconsistent for now.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Issues
options.body: Make #51441 and #9016 the canonical contracts and keep #7006 open only as OpenRouter auto footer acceptance criteria until those land.

recommendation.title: Define Additive Contract
recommendation.body: Preserve the selected `openrouter/auto` model, add resolved model/provider and provider-cost metadata, then render footer/status surfaces from that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans recent OpenRouter cost reconciliation and OpenAI-compatible transport work where `steipete` has the strongest recent history signal.
